title: fix(metadata-protocol, spec)!: the save doors and composeStacks refuse an `external` binding on a named managed datasource
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgULzXHHREefG78bonpN6vqt)_

Fixes #25211

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

Metadata-protocol: narrowed

The save-door half of ADR-0015 §4.2, after #25168 / #25192. `object.external` is allowed only on a datasource whose `schemaMode` is not `'managed'`. #25192 judged the halves a parse and a single stack can see. This PR judges the pair where the metadata API holds both sides, and where a composition does:

- **Object save door** (`saveMetaItem`, `object`): an object with `external` is judged against the datasource its own `datasource` names, read the way this door's by-name read serves it (the environment's stored row, else the code layer's registered definition). A managed one is refused with `422 INVALID_METADATA`, the finding at `external`, nothing stored.
- **Datasource save door** (`saveMetaItem`, `datasource`): a datasource saved as managed, or with no `schemaMode`, is refused with `422 INVALID_METADATA` while objects bind it with `external`. There is one finding per object, at `schemaMode`, and the row is unchanged. The objects counted are the environment's active object rows plus the registry's objects that no stored row overlays.
- **Publish re-judge** (`promoteDraftForPublish`): both halves are judged again on the draft body, so a draft that was legal when saved is refused if the other side changed before publish. `publishMetaItem` and each item of a package publish promote through it.
- **`composeStacks`** (step 3b, the artifact pass): an `external` object in one input bound to a managed datasource that another input declares is refused with `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID` (422), in either order and under `last` and `preserve`. It reuses `defineStack`'s collector, so the finding is the same text.
- **One rule:** `externalBindingDatasourceRefusal` is exported from `@objectstack/spec/data` (two api-surface rows), and every door above calls it. ⛔ There is no second copy of the judgement. The predicate's rule is unchanged, and `objectql` is untouched.

`force: true` does not skip it, because `force` acknowledges a destructive diff and this is not one. A datasource that no layer holds still gets no verdict.

## Measured (base `3e073894db`, before any edit)

A temporary probe drove the real `saveMetaItem` / `publishMetaItem` over a stateful `sys_metadata` double. A second probe ran `defineStack` + `composeStacks`. Neither probe is committed.

| Case | Base | After |
|---|---|---|
| `wh` stored with no `schemaMode`, then an object `external` on `wh` (publish) | object stored | `422 INVALID_METADATA` at `external`, no object row |
| same, `wh` stored `schemaMode: 'managed'` | stored | 422, no object row |
| same, draft save, then publish | draft stored, then promoted | the draft save is refused 422 (publish answers `404 NO_DRAFT`) |
| same, `force: true` | stored | 422 |
| `wh` federated + stored external object, then `wh` re-saved with no `schemaMode` or managed (publish and draft) | stored | `422 INVALID_METADATA` at `schemaMode`, `wh` row still `external` |
| control: `wh` `schemaMode: 'external'` | both stored | both stored |
| `composeStacks([A, B])`: A declares `wh` managed or with no `schemaMode`, B has `external` on `wh`; both `defineStack` calls build | passes under `last` and `preserve`, both orders | `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID`, 1 issue, all 8 combinations |
| control: A declares `wh` external | passes | passes |

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.external-binding-named-datasource-refusal.test.ts` (new, 22 tests): the object half (stored and registered datasource, both managed shapes, publish / draft / `force`, and the stored row read before the registered definition), the datasource half (stored and registered bound objects, one finding each, a stored overlay that drops `external`, and an object draft that binds nothing), the publish re-judge in both directions, and controls (`external` / `validate-only`, a datasource no layer holds, an object without `external`, a binding on another datasource). Each refusal asserts code, status, path and the first sentence of the finding, spelled out.
- `packages/spec/src/stack-external-binding-datasource.test.ts` (+13): `composeStacks` on the cross-input pair, both orders × `last` / `preserve` × both managed shapes, a `strict: false` input holding the pair, and the controls.
- `protocol.external-binding-primary-datasource-refusal.test.ts` (#25192): its registry double gains the `getItem` the object door now calls, and the `lake` control is relabelled "no layer holds (no verdict)". Its assertions are unchanged.
- **Ablation:** `externalBindingSaveRefusal` short-circuited to `undefined` via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `530b2be2` → `fc7f395b`). The new file went to 15 failed / 7 passed (every refusal pin red, every control green), and the restore was proven: blob == HEAD `530b2be2`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The subject resolves through the relative `./protocol.js` import (src), so no `dist/` hop is involved.

## Acceptance notes

- **The datasource-admin door is not judged here.** `DatasourceAdminService.updateDatasource` (`PATCH /api/v1/datasources/NAME`) writes through its own path, not `saveMetaItem`. Measured at base: it stores `wh` as `managed` while a stored object binds it `external`, and this PR does not touch that path. It belongs to the services lane, so it is reported to the seat as a finding and not fixed here.
- **A batch publish** is judged one promotion at a time, in batch order, against what is already active. A datasource and an object promoted in the same batch see each other only in that order.
- **The registry half** of the datasource door reads `engine.registry.getAllObjects()` when the host's registry has it, which the real `SchemaRegistry` does. A registry double without it counts stored rows only.
- **Not covered:** `installPackage`'s named-datasource half (a package carrying both sides installs through its own path), and inputs nested inside a `preserve`-composed artifact (they carry no top-level objects or datasources for step 3b).
- **A degraded metadata read** while resolving the named datasource surfaces as the read's own `503`, never as a verdict.
- **#25168's changeset** said in its **Unchanged** bullet that a stored or registered datasource gets no verdict. That changeset is left untouched, and this PR's changeset states the narrowing explicitly.
- **Docs:** `external-datasources.mdx` §5's write example now names `datasource: 'warehouse'` (as written it was a binding on `default`, which #25192 refuses), and §2 states the rule and the two doors.
- **Semantic entry** `object-external-binding-managed-datasource-refused`: amended (surface, replacement and reason) to name `composeStacks` and the two save doors. The ADR-0087 marker is `not-required (already-registered …)`.
